summary: Orders a timed-audio event range into ascending (start, end) endpoints read from the object field at +0xF3C, plays events in that range via TimedAudioEventPlayback, resets the audio ring buffer, then re-scales both endpoints by 40.0 and converts to integers. If the two integer buckets differ, it iterates all vehicles (count from dword_5C329C, pointer array dword_7C54F0), calling sub_4EE2D0 per vehicle and MultiObjectRemove for the supplied position.

operations.description: If a2 equals the sentinel value -9.9999997e37, fall back to FloatGetter(*this) to obtain the current float value.
Read the start-of-range value from object field *this + 0xF3C into v10.
Initialize v11 = a2 (end of range) and v12 = 1 (ordered flag).
If a2 < v10, swap so v11 = field +0xF3C value, v10 = a2, and mark v12 = 0 (range was reversed).
Call TimedAudioEventPlayback(*this, v10, v11, v12) to process audio events between the ordered time endpoints.
Call BufferReset(&dword_83EE60) to clear the audio ring buffer counter.
Scale the first endpoint: v3 = v10 * 40.0.
Call sub_5895A2(v3) to synchronize the audio buffer at the scaled start position.
Convert the scaled start value with CRTFtol (float-to-int) into v4.
Scale the second endpoint: v5 = v11 * 40.0.
Call sub_5895A2(v5) to synchronize the audio buffer at the scaled end position.
Convert the scaled end value with CRTFtol (float-to-int) into result.
If the two integer buckets differ (v6 != result), the range crosses a bucket boundary.
Read the vehicle count from dword_5C329C into v8.
Loop i over all vehicles in [0, v8).
Call sub_4EE2D0(dword_7C54F0[i] + 12) on each vehicle pointer from the active-vehicle array.
Call MultiObjectRemove(a2) inside the loop and store its result.
Return result (the last MultiObjectRemove result, or the CRTFtol bucket value when the loop is skipped).
